title: Example Section Summary
note: Produced by summarize_chunk (§4.2), taken from an unmodified pipeline run over the corpus. Input text is shown as an English translation by the authors for readability; the pipeline's actual input was the German source text, and the summary shown is the unmodified English output produced by the LLM from that German input.

fields.label: Input
fields.value: The Supply Chain Due Diligence Act (LkSG, Federal Law Gazette 2021 Part I No. 46, p. 2959 et seq.) entered into force on 1 January 2023 and applies to companies […] with more than 3,000 employees domestically […]. Brainloop has carefully examined the provisions […] as part of a risk analysis. As a result, it has been determined that the provisions […] do not apply to Brainloop.

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Supply chain due diligence law applicability

fields.label: Summary
fields.value: This section discusses the applicability and scope of a supply chain due diligence law, including its objectives and the organization's compliance assessment.

footnote: Translated from German by the authors; the LLM's actual input, and the source of the summary shown, was the German original.

title: Example Section Summary
note: Produced by summarize_chunk (§4.2), taken from an unmodified pipeline run over the corpus. Bold spans in the input mark the identifying information — company name and contact address — that the prompt instructs the model to strip; neither survives into the summary.

title: From PDF to DocItem Tree
note: Docling's layout model assigns each page region a type; the reading-order stream it emits is then resolved into the nested DocItem tree the pipeline consumes.
alt: Diagram: a page mockup with typed layout regions (H, Tx, DI) is flattened into a reading-order stream by Docling, then resolved by heading-hierarchy resolution and chunking into a nested DocItem tree rooted at #/body.
caption: From PDF to DocItem tree, illustrated on a document in our corpus. (a) Docling's layout model assigns each page region a type (H = section header, Tx = text, DI = document index / table); a six-element excerpt is shown. (b) The same elements as Docling emits them: a flat, ordered stream. (c) doc_chunks_to_doc_items (§4.1) resolves heading levels into the nested tree the pipeline consumes, shown here in full for this document's top level, not restricted to the (a)–(b) excerpt. The DOCUMENT_INDEX node under “Table of Contents” is retained in the tree but excluded from section text used downstream (§4.1); nested subsections (e.g., “3.1”) and their list items are resolved into proper descendants rather than a flat sequence.

title: LLM-guided Placement Search
note: LLM-guided placement of a summarized section s into the shared taxonomy T. Search recurses down one branch at a time, deciding at each node whether to stop, match, or explore further; Place arbitrates when more than one branch reports back.

lines.text: return ⟨v, a, U⟩ ∥ Search(T, last(U), s)
